dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the anterior head and posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Localized dark-pixel clusters observed around the blowhole and anterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse transitions between pigmented anterior areas and the depigmented dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A sharp, dark longitudinal mark is visible on the posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible dark longitudinal scar or mark on the lower dorsal region.
